name: Hold Me Tight (잡아줘)

lines.lyric_hangul: 술잔을 비우니, 그리움이 차는구나
lines.lyric_translation: I empty my drink but it gets filled with loneliness

lines.lyric: Geunyang da jigo bol geol wae nan ddajigo bwasseulkka
lines.lyric_hangul: 그냥 다 지고 볼 걸 왜 난 따지고 봤을까?
lines.lyric_translation: I should’ve just given in, why did I argue all the time?

lines.lyric_hangul: 길가에 버려진 쓰레기봉투까지도
lines.lyric_translation: Even the trash bag thrown away on the street

lines.lyric_translation: All I did was color you in my white, blank paper

lines.lyric: Jeongsin charyeoboni imi han pokui geurimi dwae

lines.lyric_translation: But then I realized, it already became a finished picture

lines.lyric_hangul: 너와 난 핸드폰

lines.lyric_translation: When we’re apart, you know we’ll be broken

lines.lyric_hangul: 너의 체취만이 날 온전하게 해
lines.lyric_translation: Only your scent completes me

lines.lyric_hangul: 어서 날 안아
